title: UFO targets in the remote viewing unit came as practice sessions or favors for generals

tellings.quote: all of the rest of the times that we did a lot of UFO stuff [sighs and gasps] uh came under the heading of practice sessions

plain: An Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says that in the 1980s he served in a unit doing remote viewing, the attempt to describe distant places or things using only the mind. He says much of the unit's UFO work came under the label of practice sessions, or as favors for generals, and he mentions a fellow member, Ed Dames. If true, the military was quietly pointing psychic spying at UFOs off the books.
